hints.title: Two Directed Transitions
hints.text: From index i, you can jump to either i + arr[i] or i - arr[i] if the destination stays within array bounds.

hints.title: Track Visited Indices
hints.text: Because jumping back and forth can create cycles, maintain a visited set or mark visited indices negative in place.

hints.title: BFS or DFS Reachability
hints.text: Start search at start. If arr[i] == 0 is reached, return true. If queue empties without finding 0, return false.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Without visited tracking, cyclic transitions lead to infinite recursion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Visited array bounds search to visiting each index at most once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate models the problem as graph reachability and applies BFS/DFS.
complexity.notes: Can mark arr[cur] = -arr[cur] for O(1) auxiliary space (excluding recursion stack).
